context_image.usage_description: The left 128x128 is the source sheet. The right sprite guides only the short black hair style and palette; do not copy its south-facing pose.

parameters.description: In each 64x64 cell of this 2x2 sheet add only short tousled black hair fitted to each north-facing scalp, seen from behind. Match the right-side reference hair style, scale, outline and palette. Preserve every other pixel, the back-facing head and anatomy, ears, body poses, shorts, feet and transparency. No face on the back of the head, bandana, duplicate head, clothing or loose objects. Keep original row-major frame order.
